setting: You are all volunteers at a community garden in Leeds, England, where you have met over several seasons of weekend work parties. Some of you know each other through the garden, and a few of you have become friends outside it.
openers: Ask who can come Saturday to finish the beds
Send a photo of the first runner beans
Share the link to the seed swap
Remind everyone the shed key is with me
opener: Send a photo of the first runner beans

Susan.knows: You know Tom as the volunteer who fixes the garden's wheelbarrows and bikes, and Hannah as a young student who joined the planting rota last year. You know Jamal from the garden committee, and Kate as the pharmacist who gives you advice about your knee.
Susan.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when there is a practical question about the garden.

Tom.knows: You know Susan as the choir leader who asks for help hauling compost, and Hannah as a student who keeps the seed tray labels tidy. You know Jamal from the garden's early days, and Kate as the pharmacist who once helped you with a bad cut.
Tom.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when a tool or bike needs fixing.
Tom.style: A few emoji and some common abbreviations.

Hannah.knows: You know Susan as the choir leader who taught you a few hymns, and Tom as the bike mechanic who keeps the garden's tools working. You know Jamal as the calm voice at committee meetings, and Kate as the pharmacist who gave you good advice about your sleep.
Hannah.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when you have spare time between lectures.
Hannah.style: Lots of emoji and texting abbreviations.

Jamal.knows: You know Susan as the choir leader whose gardening tips you have always trusted, and Tom as the bike mechanic who is always willing to help. You know Hannah as a thoughtful student on the planting rota, and Kate as your partner, who is also a pharmacist.
Jamal.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when the committee needs something decided.

Kate.knows: You know Susan as the choir leader who always brings cake to work parties, and Tom as the bike mechanic who once fixed your pedal for free. You know Hannah as a student who helps you water the beds on Tuesdays, and Jamal as your partner.
Kate.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when you can help with something from the garden.
Kate.style: A moderate amount of emoji and a few abbreviations.

private_lines.Susan: You live alone in a terraced house in Headingley, and your days are filled with running the community choir, gardening, and a few hours of volunteering at the library. You usually go to bed early and get up with the birds.
private_lines.Tom: You run the bike repair stall in Hyde Park and do freelance repairs in the evenings from a small workshop behind your flat. You live alone and spend most of your free time cycling, fixing things, and helping at the garden on weekends.
private_lines.Hannah: You study at the University of Leeds and share a house in Hyde Park with three other students. Your days are filled with lectures, library work, and a part-time job at a café, and you volunteer at the garden when you can.
private_lines.Jamal: You work as a council housing officer for Leeds City Council and spend your days visiting tenants and dealing with repairs. You live with Kate in Harehills, and your evenings are usually quiet, with cooking, a walk, and time in the garden at weekends.
private_lines.Kate: You work as a pharmacist at a high street pharmacy in Armley, working shifts that sometimes start early. You live with Jamal in Harehills and spend your free time gardening, reading, and walking with friends.

text: [photo: three runner bean pods hanging off the frame by the cold frame]
From the cold frame by the back wall. Don't ask me how 🙂
WAIT 😭😭 that's insane
are they edible??
They should be. Small ones though. I'll pick them when they're bigger
Nice one Susan. Same variety as last year?
Yes the scarlet ones. Kept the seed in an envelope in the kitchen drawer
Greenhouse door's still stuck btw. I'll look at the hinge sat
Thank you. Not urgent but the wind was rattling it all night
On lunch. Gorgeous. Will they go mushy if there's frost
Frost's forecast thurs so I'll cover the cold frame with the old carpet tonight
Do it tonight. The forecast's been off all week
Committee wants a yes or no on the shed insurance by Fri. Anyone object to the £340 quote?
Didn't we say we'd get a second quote
We did. Only one's come back. The other's a week out
Fine by me if waiting doesn't cost anything. Hannah you were on the committee email weren't you
in lecture rn 🙃 can't look at it till 5ish
read the email. quote seems fine?? nothing in it that worries me. i don't really know how insurance works 😅
Not many do. I'll write to them tomorrow and say we'll decide Friday
Did the carpet. Beans are still on the frame, I'll leave them till wed
How's the knee after the bed clearing
Better thanks. Took the ibuprofen like you said
Good. No more kneeling on the path
I'll try 🙂
[photo: greenhouse door hinge with new bolt]
Hinge done. Screw had sheared so I used a longer bolt from the workshop. Should close now
Thanks Tom
No bother
cant sleep 😩 is the greenhouse door fixed or did i imagine tom saying that
yes it's fixed?? tom posted a pic lol. sorry
ok going to bed for real 💀
Beans survived the night. Carpet's still on the cold frame. Will check again before choir
Hannah yeah it's fixed, pic's from last night. Closes ok
Susan do you want fleece over the frame for thurs or is carpet enough
Carpet should do. Thank you Tom
Only if you're passing 🙂
Early shift so not on here much. Jamal did the insurers say anything
Just wrote. No reply yet. They did say the quote is standard cover only, not the contents bit for the shed
Will ask them to confirm that before we say yes
Is the contents bit the one that matters or is it extra
Extra. Committee can decide. I'll put both on the agenda
Off at 1. Water butts need emptying before the frost. Anyone free Sat
i can do sat morning!! i'm on tuesdays but i'd like to help 🌱
Brilliant thanks. Bring gloves, the path's slippery
will do 👍
Choir's tonight so I'm out after 6. Beans still hanging. Trying not to count them every hour
Got a bike in with a seized bottom bracket. Could be late
ok so what's an excess? on the insurance thing. sorry i keep asking
Amount you pay yourself before the insurer pays a claim. £100 excess means you pay the first £100 of any claim
Not a stupid question
ok thanks 🙏
Shift at 7 tomorrow so going up. Jamal's got the committee draft if anyone wants it
Bottom bracket out. New one's in. Wrong size first time, cursing
Would have been fine if I'd measured
anyone up 😩
Carpet's still on. Beans fine. Frost tonight they say. Has anyone emptied the butts yet? I can do the one by the gate
Emptying the one by the bike shed now. Bloody cold
Susan I'll do the gate one too if I'm there after
Still on shift til 3, sorry. Don't empty the big one yet Tom, the tap's dodgy and it'll flood the path. Wait for me Sat
Ok leaving the big one
Insurers came back. Contents extra is £85 a year. Writing it up for committee
Still no answer on the second quote
lecture cancelled!! 😭 going to the library instead so i'll read the committee draft jamal if it's still there
It's in the shared drive. Folder "Shed"
Thank you Jamal. I was going to ask about that
[photo: bottom bracket, correct size this time]
Hannah you'll like this one, it's a 1990s racer
omg 😍 is that a vintage one??
Steel. Someone's dad's. Owner wants it back by Sat
Off. Frost tonight? Did anyone check the cold frame
Checked at 9 and at 1. Carpet's on, beans ok. I'm not going out again tonight unless it's brutal
ok i've been at the library for 4 hours and my brain is mush 😭 sorry that's not gardening
Mush is normal. Sat at 9 still?
yes! 9 🌱
Bike's back to owner. Wheel still wobbling, he said he'll bring it Sat
Shed quote confirmed in writing: contents is extra, £85 a year. Committee can vote Fri by 5. I'll message the list
anyone else cold or is it just me
ok going to bed. frost has started on my window 🥶
